name: tool_calls_with_ids
why: Two concurrent calls to ONE tool, plus a call whose result changed. Before Phase 1 a tool part was keyed by name + state + result[:80], so the same call changed identity the moment it finished, and two calls to the same tool collided on one key. Both are now keyed by the graph's run id.
notes: The two rows must stay two rows: same tool, same shape, different call. That is the activity-layer form of invariant U09.
A row's id is the part key, so the renderer's keyed row and the document's part cannot drift apart.
